description: §6.8.4 runtime: a write to a `reset-on=` trigger resets the cell to its initializer (the S447 search page: next, next, type → page 1).
rationale: §6.8.4 rule 1: "When any listed cell changes … the runtime SHALL perform `reset(@self)`: … re-evaluate the cell's initializer … and write the result." Rule 4: the reset is applied in the same flush as the triggering write, before readers. #next bumps @page twice (3); #type writes @query, which resets @page to 1. ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S447 "3b: `reset-on=` IS allowed on engine cells, checked against `rule=`" — "the new rec for engine reset, yes."
